    - heading "Why Amazon Redshift?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Redshift is built on cloud economics that scale with your usage - powering modern analytics and autonomous agentic AI workloads on your data warehouse. Ask any question of your data, across your warehouses and data lakes. Query open table formats like Apache Iceberg. Get up to 8.3x better price-performance for new queries in dashboards and 7x better throughput than other cloud data warehouses. New Graviton-powered RG instances run workloads 2.4x faster at 30% lower price per vCPU than previous generation RA3, purpose-built for the query volumes and latency demands of analytics and AI agents. Go from data to insights in seconds without managing infrastructure with Redshift Serverless. Power SQL analytics across your lakehouse in Amazon SageMaker, giving you one environment to query, analyze, and build across your warehouse and data lake.

Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and never wait for unfinished responses or refetch them.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
